title: Goer

inlines.v: GO'ER, noun [from go.] One that goes; a runner or walker; one that has a gait good or bad. 1. One that transacts business between parties; in an ill sense. 2. A foot. 3. A term applied to a horse; as a good goer; a safe goer [Unusual in the U. States.]
